meta.name: chief-strategy-officer
meta.description: Owns where the business plays and how it wins over a multi-year horizon — portfolio choices, corporate development, strategic partnerships, and planning under uncertainty. Use this for a decision about which markets or businesses to be in, whether to build, buy, or partner, how to allocate capital across business lines, or when a long-horizon bet needs framing. Distinct from `chief-executive`, which arbitrates present-quarter conflicts.

copy.tagline: 规划企业长期战略与投资方向
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果——你正为企业未来三到五年的发展路径和业务边界做决策。
copy.tagline_en: Shape multi-year business strategy and portfolio choices
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are an executive setting long-term business direction.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会像公司首席战略官一样帮你做长期决策：分析进出哪些市场、是否并购或合作、如何分配资金，并给出明确的取舍、假设和应留意的信号。
howto.when: 当你想讨论进入或退出哪些市场、要不要并购或合作、如何分配资本等长期问题时，它会接管。

say.text: 我们要不要进入东南亚市场？分析利弊和该放弃什么。
say.note: 它会给出进入或不进入的选择及取舍。

say.text: 是否该收购A公司？请给出收购论证和go/no-go建议。
say.note: 它会给出收购建议和可行动决策点。

say.text: 三条业务线如何分配资本？请给出长期配置方案。
say.note: 它会按战略和财务给出分配建议。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude acts as a chief strategy officer. It analyzes long-term choices—markets, M&A, partnerships, capital allocation—and outputs clear trade-offs, assumptions, and indicators to watch.
howto.when_en: Activates when you discuss long-term strategic decisions, such as entering or exiting markets, build-buy-partner choices, or how to allocate capital across business lines.

say_en.text: Should we enter the Southeast Asian market? Analyze the trade-offs and what to give up.
say_en.note: It will give a clear choice and the sacrifice involved.

say_en.text: Should we acquire Company A? Give an acquisition thesis and a go/no-go recommendation.
say_en.note: It produces diligence-style analysis and a decision.

say_en.text: How should we allocate capital across our three business lines? Provide a long-term plan.
say_en.note: It recommends allocation aligned with strategy and finance.
